instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot, eye-level. The setting is an indoor motion capture studio with a dark red carpet, wooden flooring, and an office copier visible in the background. The man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the right, facing away from the camera. The woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left, facing right. She extends her right arm to touch the man's (R1) left shoulder from behind. Overhead indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the floor.
elements: R2 reaches from behind to touch R1's left shoulder
R1 receives the shoulder touch from R2 rather than initiating it
R2 uses her right arm for the contact on R1's shoulder
